entities.name: Joseph J. McDowell
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joseph Jefferson McDowell was an American lawyer and politician who served as two-term a U.S. Representative from Ohio from 1843 to 1847. He was the son of Joseph McDowell, a prominent North Carolina politician who served in the Revolutionary War and was also a member of Congress.
